name_zh: 顿巴斯矿业/农业巨头：资源诅咒缓解与战争经济重构
name_en: Donbas Mining/Agribusiness Giants: Resource Curse Mitigation & War Economy Reconstruction
description_zh: 乌克兰资源经济由两大支柱支撑：顿巴斯煤炭/钢铁工业带 (顿涅茨克/卢甘斯克) 与黑土地农业出口 (小麦/玉米/葵花籽油全球前列)。2014 年以来战争导致顿巴斯工业基地 70%+ 受损/失控，农业出口被黑海封锁切断。核心重构逻辑：西部利沃夫/外喀尔巴阡建立备用工业/物流枢纽、丹麦/波兰/罗马尼亚协助谷物陆运团 (团结通道)、绿色钢铁/氢能/关键矿产 (锂/钛/稀土) 转型、战后重建基金 (乌克兰基金/世界银行/欧盟) 锚定绿色工业化。体现 M168 资源诅咒缓解——以"战争倒逼转型+外部援助锚定+绿色重建"三位一体，将资源诅咒转化为绿色工业跃升契机。
description_en: Ukraine's resource economy rests on two pillars: Donbas coal/steel belt (Donetsk/Luhansk) and chernozem agricultural exports (wheat/corn/sunflower oil global top). Since 2014 war, Donbas industrial base 70%+ damaged/lost, agricultural exports cut by Black Sea blockade. Core reconstruction logic: western Lviv/Transcarpathia backup industrial/logistics hubs, Danish/Polish/Romanian grain land corridors (Solidarity Lanes), green steel/hydrogen/critical minerals (lithium/titanium/REE) transition, reconstruction funds (Ukraine Fund/WB/EU) anchoring green reindustrialization. Exemplifies M168 Resource Curse Mitigation—trinity of 'war-forced transition + external aid anchoring + green reconstruction' converting resource curse into green industrial leap opportunity.
reason_zh: 乌克兰资源诅咒非单纯荷兰病，而是"战争摧毁核心产区+出口通道被切+寡头垄断收益"三重夹击。重构路径独特在于"战争倒逼+外部援助+绿色转型"三位一体：战争迫使产业西移/多元化，西方援助锚定绿色标准，重建资金杠杆杠杆绿色工业。M168 区隔于 M39 鸟笼经济(通用)、M169 后资源转型(沙特)、M175 水资源联邦(跨界)，核心在于"战争经济重构+绿色跃升"的极限案例。
reason_en: Ukraine's resource curse not mere Dutch disease but triple squeeze of 'war destroys core production zones + export routes cut + oligopolistic rent capture'. Reconstruction path unique in 'war-forced + external aid + green transition' trinity: war forces industrial westward shift/diversification, Western aid anchors green standards, reconstruction funds leverage green industry. M168 distinct from M39 Birdcage Economy (general), M169 Post-Resource Transition (Saudi), M175 Water Federalism (transboundary), core: 'war economy reconstruction + green leap' extreme case.
steps_zh: 战争倒逼产业西移：2014 顿巴斯失控→利沃夫/文尼察/外喀尔巴阡建立 IT/军工/物流/农产品加工新集群
团结通道谷物突围：2022 黑海封锁→波兰/罗马尼亚/立陶宛铁路/河运/港口联运，年出口恢复 4000 万吨+
关键矿产战略转型：锂(谢夫琴科夫斯克/多布罗韦利奇卡)/钛/稀土/石墨，欧盟/美/日韩战略伙伴协议，绿色供应链锚定
绿色钢铁与氢能：扎波罗热/马里乌波尔(失控前)电弧炉/氢还原铁试点，战后重建锚定零碳钢铁
重建基金绿色杠杆：乌克兰基金/世界银行/欧盟设施 500 亿+ 欧元，附带绿色/反腐/数字化条件，市场化招商
steps_en: War-forced industrial westward shift: 2014 Donbas lost -> Lviv/Vinnytsia/Transcarpathia establish IT/defense/logistics/agro-processing new clusters
Solidarity Lanes grain breakout: 2022 Black Sea blockade -> PL/RO/LT rail/river/port intermodal, annual exports recover 40M+ tonnes
Critical minerals strategic transition: lithium (Shevchenkivske/Dobrovelychivka)/titanium/REE/graphite, EU/US/Japan/Korea strategic partnerships, green supply chain anchored
Green steel & hydrogen: Zaporizhzhia/Mariupol (pre-loss) EAF/hydrogen DRI pilots, post-war reconstruction anchors zero-carbon steel
Reconstruction fund green leverage: Ukraine Fund/WB/EU facilities 50B+ EUR, conditional on green/anti-corruption/digitalization, market-based investment mobilization
expected_zh: 以"战争倒逼+外部援助+绿色转型"三位一体，将资源诅咒转化为绿色工业跃升契机，战后乌克兰目标：欧盟绿色工业后方、关键矿产安全供应链、粮食安全保障者。
expected_en: Trinity of 'war-forced + external aid + green transition' converts resource curse into green industrial leap opportunity, post-war Ukraine targets: EU green industrial rear, critical minerals secure supply chain, food security guarantor.
case_zh: 2021 粮食出口 5000 万吨/2022 封锁跌至 1500 万/2023 团结通道恢复 4000 万+；锂储量欧盟前三；绿色钢铁试点 2023 启动；重建估算 $4000 亿+，绿色条件附带。
case_en: 2021 grain exports 50Mt/2022 blockade drop to 15Mt/2023 Solidarity Lanes recover 40Mt+; lithium reserves EU top 3; green steel pilot 2023 launched; reconstruction est. $400B+, green conditions attached.
